_comment: The vol 10 cast as hero slots for the Meshy pipeline. Each entry is one text-to-3D generation (Meshy) → GLB installed via godot/tools/hero_uploader/ into godot/assets/3d/characters/heroes/ under 'file' → instanced by build_strip_panel.py per staging job. 'meshy_prompt' is the text-to-3D brief; 'texture_prompt' the Meshy texturing pass. One model per age; expressions come from pose + camera + the comic's own ink, not from the mesh. NOTE (the authorial rule): there is no 'arthur' hero. Wood is the character; the author is never staged. comic_look: the strip's own description per era (from lore/drift_wood/style/characters.md); the comic prompt builder uses it, ahead of the meshy_prompt, so a character's look on the page is the strip's, not the 3D model's.
